windows.text: You’re regularly having sex, going out together, spending time alone together, and doing things you wouldn’t do with a regular friend, so it feels like it’s filling a relationship void, but only accidentally and occasionally—maybe just enough to keep you from looking for anything deeper.

windows.text: Going slowly can show you how somebody’s moods move over time, how they treat you, and how they treat other people, but it still can’t tell you how good the sex will be or how either of you will act afterward.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: You can know somebody for twenty years and then discover on the first night that the polarity isn’t there.

windows.label: Human
windows.text:
Touch or smell can feel wrong, or your desire levels or kinks don’t fit. Maybe one person is sexually shut down, or the bodies just don’t connect.
Some of those things might get better if both partners are committed to helping each other through it.

windows.label: Human
windows.text:
Sometimes bad sexual fit still feels like, “Let’s just be friends!”
Saying, “The sex isn’t working for me,” may sound like, “I only love you if the sex is good.” But universal love doesn’t make someone special.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: It isn’t romance.

windows.label: Human
windows.text:
It’s the basis of any good relationship of any kind.
I can still love her and not want to be in a romantic relationship with her. Romantic love generally needs good sex too, or we’re friends who care deeply about each other.

windows.text: Crying also contains a type of automatic erratic breathwork. Breathwork is one of the easiest ways I know to calm down. Reduced breathing or the Buteyko method is especially useful to me when my partner is getting me upset and flustered with drama.

Meditation is also helpful, but for most people, I would still put inner-child reparenting, peer counseling, and body-based work first or make them primary meditation targets. Many people say they cannot meditate or have not gotten to that stage yet, and meditation without grounding in those approaches can easily be a road into spiritual bypassing.

r15-ideal.headline: Mostly Human Written

windows.label: Human
windows.text: Idealization can be pathological, but it can also come very close to real deep love and appreciation.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: That’s why it’s so easy to get confused.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: So far in my life the main experiences of this have been with Bee and Key. They’re also the two women I’ve actually been (through) ght out this divine-feminine beauty in them that made me into a real love slave.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: I’m not Superman out here trying to “save a hoe.” There’s just a natural director/muse dynamic that sometimes plays out in an exaggerated way.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: It shouldn’t have to happen that way, though.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: It’s a bad shortcut to the divine archetypes.

windows.label: Human
windows.text:
Legitimately seeing someone as amazing doesn’t depend on what the seeing gives you. You’re already lost in the sauce once you start identifying with the way you see them, like she’s perfect, this is destiny, I’m the one who finally found her.
The degree of idealization also predicts the degree of demonization for me. I don’t mean this as a clinical diagnosis, but I use it almost diagnostically in my own life.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: If a woman says, “You’re such a great guy.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: Of course you have flaws like anyone, but I love you,” that sounds healthy.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: If she says, “You’re perfect.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: I can’t find any flaw,” I’m already running.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: When the BPD splitting happens, private hatred can replace worship, and then come public accusations, rewriting the whole past and treating every flaw as proof that the person was fake all along.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: Sometimes the woman who thought I was perfect later accuses me of thinking I’m perfect.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: I’ve learned to get nervous when somebody knows too much about me too soon. We’re twin flames. She knows my motives.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: I’m Lord Krishna.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: Okay, maybe I really am way better than the other guys she’s found. But if she hasn’t found anything about me that bothers her yet, she hasn’t found all of me.

windows.label: Human
windows.text:
For example, I still love women I’ve loved before. Sometimes I talk about them because I’m thinking about them. I’m not trying to make her jealous. If she can’t handle that I still love them, she isn’t ready for me.
If she says, “Can you talk less about your exes?” Sure.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: Maybe I do talk about them too much sometimes. But they still matter to me. If I’m supposed to listen to everything on her mind, I don’t want to have to pretend that isn’t on mine.
